metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code skills and mods by Karol Novljaković.

plugins.name: walkthrough
plugins.description: Record narrated design walkthroughs and step-by-step tutorials of a real web app: Playwright drives the UI, an animated pointer guides the eye, and Chatterbox, Kokoro or ElevenLabs narrates.

plugins.name: slack-nag
plugins.description: Schedule friendly, backing-off "nagging bot" follow-ups in a Slack thread until someone answers; each nudge checks the thread first and stays quiet once answered.

plugins.name: blueprint
plugins.description: Architect larger changes from a solution you already have: a short solution-first grilling, a spec change with diagrams and optional interactive playgrounds, stored in Notion, Obsidian, Linear, Jira, GitHub or a notes folder, two-way sync that keeps specs and code from drifting, a local capability map with search and drift, scenario coverage that traces each spec scenario to the tests tagged as claiming it, a ready-made GitHub Action that reports drift on every PR, and tidy, which groups capabilities into domains and migrates older setups.

plugins.name: blueprint-ui
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat that shows blueprint reviews, briefs and specs read-only, batches comments and suggested wording like a pending GitHub review, and hands the batch to /blueprint review. A mod; install it next to blueprint.
